olivia (sec-eng): Heads-up — upcoming RBAC change will restrict audit subscriptions to tenant-scoped subscriptions only. This may break customers who relied on org-level audit exports. Any objections?

sam (eng-infra): Noted. Do we have a migration path? Right now webhook/S3 exporters accept a `tenant_id` header but org-level exports were relying on no tenant filter.

priya (compliance): We need to keep a clear audit trail per tenant for compliance, but customers should be able to opt into consolidated exports. Can we support an `org_id` in the event payload?

jared (platform): We can add `org_id` to the top-level audit event, but need to consider PII/KMS scoping. If events are encrypted w/ per-tenant KMS keys, org-level consumers might not have access.

olivia (sec-eng): Good point. Two issues: (1) schema change to include `org_id` and (2) delivery auth + KMS access for org-level exports.

audit-bot: delivery.failure: webhook delivery failed -> 403 (missing key access) for customer `tenant:acme-corp` at 2023-08-02T12:03:21Z

sam (eng-infra): Quick reality check — Splunk/SIEM customers often ingest pre-encrypted blobs or expect plaintext JSON. For S3 exports we currently upload gzipped JSON with S3/KMS envelope encryption. If we add `org_id`, it's safe, but encrypted payloads will still be tenant-keyed.

lia (solutions): Customer-facing ask: let customers register a "subscription" at org-level that will be billed/managed by a tenant admin who authorizes a delegated KMS key. Can we support a subscription object that references a KMS alias?

mike (sre): Implementation-wise: the delivery pipeline needs to check identity -> decrypt (if needed) -> transform -> re-encrypt with subscription KMS if org-export requested. That adds latency and CPU. We should quantify.

priya (compliance): Also audit schema change requires versioning. Please include `audit_schema_version` and `event_metadata.schema_changes` in the payload so downstream parsers can handle old vs new.

olivia (sec-eng): Agree. Proposed minimal API/payload changes: add `org_id` (nullable), `audit_schema_version` (string), and `delivery_subscription_id` (string). Keep `tenant_id` primary for tenant-scoped events. Example snippet:
```json
{
  "audit_schema_version": "v2",
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "timestamp": "2023-08-02T12:00:00Z",
  "tenant_id": "t-acme",
  "org_id": "o-acme-parent",
  "actor": { "id": "u-123", "type": "user" },
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "resource": { "type": "model", "id": "m-789" },
  "delivery_subscription_id": "sub-222"
}
```

jared (platform): +1. For KMS: add a subscription-level key policy that allows our service principal to re-wrap objects to the subscription key. We can implement envelope rewrap using the KMS Encrypt/Decrypt + ReEncrypt primitive where available, else do decrypt/re-encrypt in a secure worker.

sam (eng-infra): Action items: 1) Add `org_id` + schema version (owner: olivia) 2) Delivery flow changes to support rewrap (owner: jared) 3) Docs + onboarding checklist for customers that want org-level exports (owner: lia) 4) Backwards compat webhook header mapping for older SIEMs (owner: sam)

olivia (sec-eng): Timeline? We should aim for a phased rollout: schema and header mapping in 2 weeks, rewrap support and subscription KMS in 6 weeks.

lia (solutions): I'll draft a migration note for customers: include examples for Splunk HEC vs S3 vs webhook and a sample policy for KMS alias delegation.

priya (compliance): Also need to update the audit retention matrix and customer contract language for org-level shared exports. I'll coordinate legal.

mike (sre): One more: add a health metric and alert for rewrap failures -> route to eng-infra on-call. We saw a similar surge when we added cross-tenant backups.

olivia (sec-eng): Thanks all. I'll open a PR with the schema draft and add the migration plan to the onboarding repo. If anyone has strong objections to `org_id` being top-level, speak now. Otherwise I'll proceed. :thumbsup:

sam (eng-infra): No objections. +1 from infra.

lia (solutions): No objections. Will prep customer comms.

jared (platform): Fine from platform side.

priya (compliance): Approved.

audit-bot: ticket.created: AUDIT-6723 "Org-level audit subscription migration" assigned to olivia (sec-eng)

olivia (sec-eng): Thanks — I'll track and follow up with PR link here when ready.
